name: AI Engineering Maturity
description: Cache load → 8-stage maturity assessment

name: Beta Ready Checklist
description: Cache load → beta checklist → drift gate

name: Bug Hunt
description: Cache load → bug scan (report-only). For fixes use bug-hunt-fix or pass "fix" in args

name: Bug Hunt Deep
description: Bug hunt (report) → security → schema → test safety → test gaps. Fix variant bug-hunt-fix-deep

name: Bug Hunt and Fix
description: Cache load → hunt → apply safe fixes → test safety → verify tests

name: Bug Hunt Fix Deep
description: Deep hunt with fixes → security suggest → test safety → tests for regressions

name: Bug Hunt Pre-Deploy
description: Drift gate → bug hunt (report) → security → test safety. Fix variant append "fix" to args

name: Bug Hunt Pre-Deploy Fix
description: Drift → hunt with safe fixes → security → test safety → schema check

name: Cache Freshness Watch
description: L1 cache staleness report then verifier gate

name: Cache Rebuild
description: Cache load → full codebase scan and cache write

name: Chain Health Watch
description: L1 chain registry audit report then verifier gate

name: CI Branch Readiness
description: Cache → branch CI/CD analysis (per-wave) → GitHub policy → git guardrails; block push on BLOCKED

name: Code Review (diff-scoped)
description: Lean, token-efficient review of the working diff — correctness + obvious issues; security pass only when auth/secrets/permissions change. Report-only.

name: Complex Task Orchestration
description: Cache load then orchestrator decomposition for multi-domain work

name: Cyber Essentials Bug Hunt
description: CE assess → bug hunt → security audit for code compliance gaps

name: Cyber Essentials Maturity
description: CE assess → AI engineering maturity → security audit for SDLC posture

name: Cyber Essentials Pre-Deploy
description: Drift gate → CE assess → pre-deploy bug hunt → security audit

name: Cyber Essentials Review
description: UK NCSC Cyber Essentials code/config assess → deep security audit

name: Database Design
description: Data architect ER design → schema audit → engine expert (manifest-driven). Cache-first.

name: Safe Delivery
description: Branch alignment → diff-scoped code review → git guardrails → tests when code changed

name: Deploy Check
description: Drift → hardened Docker → GitHub workflows → git guardrails → DO deploy → eval

name: Deploy DNS and Perimeter
description: Route 53 app + email DNS (DKIM) → DO firewall → SES verify → git commit DNS JSON

name: Didit Identity Setup
description: Drift gate → Didit KYC/KYB integration

name: Docker Deploy Setup
description: Hardened image → CI workflow → GitHub policy → git guardrails → DO registry

name: Full Documentation
description: Cache load → codebase scan (optional) → README → GitHub Docs-style site + cache

name: Documentation Refresh
description: Cache load → README polish → doc set update (no full scan)

name: End of Day Shutdown
description: Close TODO → README → token report → ddev-cleanup (mandatory clean git) → emit useful daily learnings to vault graph (self-learning brain) if activity detected. All changes committed, porcelain empty, brain updated.

name: Filament Panel Review
description: Cache load → panel audit → security follow-up

name: Frontend UI and Components
description: HTML/Tailwind ui_spec → stack expert (Laravel/Livewire/HTMX/Go default; SPA only when manifest matches)

name: GitHub CI Watch
description: L1 GitHub Actions health report then verifier gate

name: GitHub Workflow Setup
description: Cache → CI policy review → workflow/secrets CRUD → security audit → git delivery

name: Laravel Database Design
description: Full stack DB design — architect → model check → Laravel → engine → Filament. Cache-first.

name: Laravel Feature
description: Branch alignment → Laravel expert → test safety and tests when code changes

name: Loop Daily Triage
description: L1 triage report then verifier gate

name: Loop Engineering Audit
description: Cache load → loop maturity and readiness assessment

name: Loqate Address Setup
description: Drift gate → Loqate Address Capture integration

name: Migration Safe
description: Schema check → audit → test safety → engine → Laravel models (when laravel)

name: PayPal Billing Setup
description: Drift gate → PayPal integration configuration

name: Pre-Flight Check
description: Branch scope → drift scan → test DB safety before starting work

name: Production DB Operations
description: Drift gate → prod DB maintenance → post-maintenance eval

name: Promote Master
description: Audit develop → sync master conflicts → merge develop to master via PR

name: Push Secrets Guard
description: GitHub posture review → git guardrails with mandatory secrets/env pre-push hooks (GitGuardian-safe)

name: QA Gate (after complex work)
description: After bug-hunt / rotation / analysis → qa-agent gate for sign-off

name: QA Pre-Deploy
description: Full qa-agent pre-deploy (risks, tests, domain, readiness)

name: QA Pre-PR Gate
description: Cache → qa-agent pre-pr (diff focus, safety, domain risks, tests). Pass specialization (e.g. facebook-stats, e-ndsign) via skill_args or invocation.

name: QA Scan
description: Cache load → qa-agent scan (report + checklist). Lightweight health check.

name: Repo Health Check
description: GitHub audit → git workflow verification → drift and sync gates

name: Repo Health Watch
description: L1 branch/PR hygiene report then verifier gate

name: Research Deep Dive (external)
description: Cache load → perspective frame → gather (user-approved sources) → research memo

name: Security Review
description: Security audit with test DB safety gate

name: SES Email Setup
description: Route 53 email DNS (DKIM/SPF/DMARC) then Amazon SES — use deploy-dns-infra for go-live

name: Session End (mid-day pause)
description: Pause work to leave and return later the same day. Captures WIP checkpoint, optional TODO resume note, workspace pointer + light vault pause lesson. Does NOT require clean git, does NOT stop ddev, does NOT run full eod-shutdown.

name: Session Start
description: Resume-first gate → standup (runtime + resume-branch) → security sweep → lean cache load (0 files when card fresh) → compound gate → working mode

name: Template Deploy
description: Cache load then deploy .grok + root chains to target project

name: Token Monitor
description: Sync Grok session context size, log trends, warn on bloat and cache misses

name: Vector DB Fit Assessment
description: Assess whether project benefits from vector DB — report-only recommendation. Cache-first.

name: Vector DB Setup
description: Vector store selection, RAG schema, hybrid search — cache-first; optional ER via data-architect

name: Web Build and Design
description: Design lead → frontend UI spec → stack expert (Laravel/Go default; SPA when manifest matches) → README

name: Wiki Ingest
description: Ingest one raw source into the LLM wiki (propose multi-page updates, index + log). L1 approval for writes; dual-write vault when accepted.

name: Wiki Lint
description: L1 health check of the LLM wiki (contradictions, orphans, stale sources). Report-only; no auto-fix.

name: Wiki Lint Watch
description: L1 wiki health (wiki_lint_check + host snapshot) then loop-verifier. Report-only; manual until scheduled.

name: Wiki Query
description: Answer a question from the wiki (index-first, capped pages). Optional file-back.

name: Workflow Debug / Failure Diagnosis
description: Cache load → github-workflow-expert (diagnose-failure.sh + log analysis) → github-expert (policy) → git-workflow-guardrails (apply fix + commit). Stops continual CI failures with root-cause + exact remediation.
